en.details: Streamline self-billing by automatically creating, managing, and exchanging electronic documents for self-billed invoices as part of the invoice lifecycle. This reduces manual document handling while helping ensure self-billed transactions include the appropriate electronic documents in standardized formats used by local regulations and trading partners. Benefits • Automate electronic document generation and handling for self-billed invoices. • Integrate electronic documents directly into the self-billing invoice lifecycle. • Support consistent vendor communications and the use of standardized electronic document formats.
